scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for every real parameter in the stated interval. Exact rational computations bundled with the package only verify the recurrence and factorization on a finite grid; they are not used to infer the infinite theorem. Bibliographic noncoverage remains subject to terminology risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equal-stake Bernoulli averages at threshold \(1/3\) and success probabilities \(0<p\le1/3\). It does not optimize over arbitrary convex stake sequences and therefore does not prove Csóka's conjecture on the entire slice.
title: Strict subcritical Chaundy–Bullard monotonicity at the one-third threshold
